label: bug: the Pi classifier route is gated on an exact Pi package version (PI_PACKAGE_VERSION = '0.99.2' at jev-transport.mjs:36, compared with strict inequality at :374) and the installed Pi is 1.5.0, so every classifier call falls through to the jev CLI; because the automatic route reports a failed gate only when the transport was explicitly 'pi' (:556), the silent fallback means the documented default 'yes-or-no and choice questions go to Pi's built-in classifier first' (v4.0.0.3.md:259) never runs, and a machine with no stored Jev key has no working classifier at all. Verify: pi --version prints 1.5.0; grep -n 'PI_PACKAGE_VERSION|pi.version !==' jev-transport.mjs

drift: v4.0.0.3 documents four Jev features and four off-switches (JEV_FEATURE_CITE_DRIFT, JEV_FEATURE_INJECTION_SCREEN, JEV_FEATURE_VERDICT_FALLBACK, JEV_FEATURE_HALLUCINATION_GRADER at v4.0.0.3.md:251) while the shared registry holds two (cite-drift, injection-screen at jev-features.mjs:38); VERDICT_FALLBACK and HALLUCINATION_GRADER appear in the changelog only and featureSwitch throws on unregistered names (:84), so two documented switches are unreachable; both missing features are scoped to /deep:model-benchmark, which this line does not ship (commands/deep holds ai-council.md, research.md, review.md and assets with no deep-model-benchmark file), so JEV_FEATURES=0 turns off two features and the note's --grader auto section describes an absent command. Verify: grep -rc JEV_FEATURE_VERDICT_FALLBACK .skilled/ excluding changelog returns nothing; ls .skilled/commands/deep/

bug (diagnostics): jevReady spawns `jev auth status` with a 10s timeout (jev-features.mjs:152) and maps every non-zero outcome to the fixed reason 'no stored credential' (:156), ignoring result.error and result.signal; a spawnSync timeout returns status null with ETIMEDOUT, so a hung probe, a killed probe and an unauthenticated CLI all read as the same sentence and the operator repairs the credential when the probe never completed. featureReady propagates the reason unchanged (:176), so it is the only diagnosis a hook or caller receives. Verify: node -e "import('./.skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/jev-features.mjs').then(m=>console.log(m.jevReady({PATH:'/usr/bin'},{spawnSyncFn:()=>({status:null,error:{code:'ETIMEDOUT'}})}).reason))" prints 'no stored credential'

improvement (test blind spot): the Pi transport's version gate is exercised only against a fixture that defaults to the same literal the module pins (stubPiPackage(root, version = '0.99.2') at tests/jev-transport.test.mjs:48), so 69/69 tests pass while the real install (Pi 1.5.0) fails the single gate that disables the whole Pi route; an assertion that a different version skips the route, or a fixture reading the installed manifest, would have surfaced f-iter021-001 on the day it landed. Verify: node --test .skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/tests/ reports 69 pass; read the fixture default at line 48

over-engineering: which() is copied verbatim into two sibling modules of the same directory (jev-features.mjs:115, jev-transport.mjs:294) with the same empty-entry skip and the same isFile + X_OK test; removing one and sharing the other breaks nothing — both are private, no third caller exists — and the pair already drifted on its default timeout (10s at jev-features.mjs:49 vs 30s at jev-transport.mjs:39), so a fix to one copy leaves the other different. Verify: grep -n '^function which' .skilled/skills/cli-classifier/shared/scripts/*.mjs

improvement: the Pi route's criteria parity with the jev CLI rests on an unverified comment — choiceRequestFrom drops a -o pair with no '=' because 'it is dropped exactly as the CLI's own criteria reader drops it' (jev-transport.mjs:117) — and if the CLI instead errors or keeps the bare key the two routes answer different questions, which choicePayloadFor's all-keys-must-be-finite rule (:219) turns into a silent fallback rather than a visible mismatch; no test pins the CLI's behaviour. Verify without a key: jev choice --help, then a malformed-pair call expected to fail at argument parsing, comparing exit code and parsed criteria

direction: Key storage or key leakage in the cli-jev transport
reason: Neither module reads, holds or prints a key: the Pi route lets ModelRuntime.create() resolve credentials from Pi's own store (jev-transport.mjs:351) and the CLI route passes the environment through unchanged; the key-never-echoed playbook case is consistent with the code read

direction: Timeout stacking between the Pi and CLI legs of one classifier call
reason: One deadline is shared: spawnCliWithinBudget recomputes the remaining budget before the CLI leg (jev-transport.mjs:495) and the Pi leg is bounded by promiseWithinTimeout with an AbortController (:563), so the legs cannot sum past the caller's timeout
